project_type: Laravel 13 / PHP 8.4 monolith, Blade templates, Vite bundler
build_system: Vite 8 with @tailwindcss/vite ^4.0. No tailwind.config.js. Run 'npm run build' after view changes to recompile assets. IMPORTANT: never use arbitrary bracket Tailwind values or the 'prose' class.
test_framework: PHPUnit via 'php artisan test --compact'. 55 tests in tests/Feature and tests/Unit.
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: run 'php artisan test --compact' and confirm all 55 tests pass. Run 'vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent' on all modified PHP/Blade files.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. Do NOT touch any PHP class files (controllers, models, migrations, Form Requests, service providers, routes). Do NOT delete resources/views/storefront/partials/product-card.blade.php — only new component views replace its usage in rewritten pages.
contribution_requirements: Tailwind v4 only — no arbitrary brackets, no tailwind.config.js, no @tailwindcss/typography prose class. CSRF on all POST forms. All {{ }} output escaping. Flash keys: session('success') and session('error'). THREE-CASE image: str_starts_with($product->image,'http') ? $product->image : ($product->image ? Storage::disk('public')->url($product->image) : asset('images/placeholder.png')). Run vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent after any PHP/Blade edits.
key_patterns: Layouts extend via @extends('layouts.admin') or @extends('layouts.storefront'). Admin sections: @section('title'), @section('page-title'), @section('content'), @stack('scripts'). Storefront sections: @section('meta_title'), @section('meta_description'), @section('og_tags'), @section('content'), @stack('scripts'). $navCategories is shared to 'layouts.storefront' via View::composer in AppServiceProvider — never pass it from a controller. Admin sidebar routes: admin.dashboard, admin.categories.*, admin.subcategories.*, admin.products.*. Toggle active: POST route + @csrf. Delete: POST + @csrf + @method('DELETE') + onsubmit confirm(). AJAX subcategory URL pattern: route('admin.subcategories.byCategory', ['category' => '__ID__']) with __ID__ replaced in JS.
directory_structure: resources/views/layouts/ — admin.blade.php + storefront.blade.php. resources/views/components/ — to be created: badge.blade.php, alert.blade.php, empty-state.blade.php, admin/stat-card.blade.php, admin/page-header.blade.php, storefront/product-card.blade.php, storefront/breadcrumb.blade.php. resources/views/admin/ — auth/login, dashboard/index, categories/{index,create,edit}, subcategories/{index,create,edit}, products/{index,create,edit}. resources/views/storefront/ — home, category, subcategory, product, partials/product-card (keep existing). tests/Feature/Admin/ — AuthTest, CategoryCrudTest, SubcategoryCrudTest, ProductCrudTest, AdminDashboardTest. tests/Feature/StorefrontTest.
